name: AutoWrite
summary: AI blog writer for Shopify with SEO scoring, scheduling and publishing. Free plan available. New to the App Store: zero reviews as of 18 Aug 2026.
best_for: Shopify stores that want to test AI-written blog posts with SEO scoring at no cost, and who treat the output as a first draft rather than as publishable copy
skip_if: you need a tool with a track record — there is none here yet — or you publish content where accuracy matters enough that an unreviewed generator is a liability
honest_knock: The honest thing to say about this one is that there is nothing to judge yet: on 18 August 2026 the App Store listing showed a rating of 0.0 from zero reviews. Not one merchant has publicly reported using it. That is not a criticism of the product, it is a statement about the evidence — an AI blog writer that nobody has reviewed is a bet, and it should be priced as one. The category it sits in is also crowded with tools that have years of track record behind them.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month, billed every 30 days in USD
pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-19 in a browser on apps.shopify.com/autowrite, because the plan table renders client-side and a plain fetch returns nothing) Four tiers, metered on posts, images and workflows per month. Free: 10 posts, 10 images, 1 workflow, basic SEO. Starter $9: 30 posts, 30 images, 3 workflows, brand voices, auto-publish, expert SEO. Pro $29: 100 posts, 100 images, 10 workflows, product references, generation priority. Business $79: 300 posts, 300 images, 30 workflows, support priority. All charges are billed in USD every 30 days. Correction to our own earlier note: on 18 August we wrote that the listing showed no paid tiers, which was our reading failing on a client-side table, not the vendor withholding prices.
